additional_controlled_host_counterexampl.title: ESP containment is checked after possible exposure to the guest
additional_controlled_host_counterexampl.observed: An extra source-ESP symlink to a controlled marker outside synthetic checkout is followed by shared copytree and accepted by check_esp. The actual delegate reaches its execute boundary with the marker copied as regular bytes in its FAT ESP. execute was intercepted before QEMU, no guest launched or personal data used. Post-run validator rejects, but after the exposure boundary.
additional_controlled_host_counterexampl.fix: Before delegation/copytree require the exact two source ESP files and reject links/special files/foreign ancestors; retain postcopy/postrun hash and set checks.
